name: round-1959
title: Fix round #1959 — nine items landed on main 1674ab59 (2026-10-10)

cases.title: A circle inscribed in bare letters now draws the INSCRIBED circle
cases.lookFor: The circle sits INSIDE the triangle, touching all three sides
cases.before: The circle was drawn THROUGH A, B and C — the opposite circle, green

cases.title: The same on four letters
cases.lookFor: The circle sits inside the square, touching all four sides
cases.before: The circle was drawn through the vertices, green

cases.title: The opposite direction is unchanged (regression guard)
cases.lookFor: The circle passes THROUGH A, B and C — this reading must not have moved
cases.before: unchanged

cases.title: REFUSAL — five letters stay a known tool limit
cases.lookFor: «הכלי עדיין לא יודע לשרטט מעגל חסום במחומש — זו מגבלה של הכלי.», nothing drawn
cases.before: unchanged

cases.title: A regular pentagon inscribed in a circle DRAWS its circle
cases.lookFor: A regular pentagon AND a visible circle through all five vertices
cases.before: The pentagon was drawn green with NO circle anywhere — the circle you named silently gone

cases.title: A plain pentagon in a circle: five vertices, unequal sides, re-samplable
cases.lookFor: A visible circle with five vertices on it and UNEQUAL sides; «הציגו תצורה אחרת» changes the pentagon's shape while every vertex stays on the circle
cases.before: Refused / escalated — nothing deterministic

cases.title: The hexagon too — the class, not just the reported pentagon
cases.lookFor: A visible circle with six vertices on it, unequal sides
cases.before: Escalated to the model

cases.title: «בר חסימה» still HIDES the circle
cases.lookFor: The pentagon is drawn and there is NO circle — «בר חסימה» means the vertices are concyclic, not that the circle is shown
cases.before: Escalated

cases.title: REFUSAL — the opposite direction keeps its known limit
cases.lookFor: «הכלי עדיין לא יודע לשרטט מעגל חסום במחומש — זו מגבלה של הכלי.», nothing drawn
cases.before: unchanged

cases.title: The same line twice mints no second circle
cases.lookFor: The second line answers «זה כבר קיים באיור — אין מה להוסיף.», and there is still exactly ONE circle and ONE step row — no second centre stacked on the first
cases.before: The line did not build at all

cases.title: Three facts on one line: ONE numbered list, from (1)
lines: משולש ABC ישר זווית ב-B ו-AB = 4
cases.lookFor: «… כתבו בשורות נפרדות: (1) משולש ABC  (2) ∠ABC = 90°  (3) AB = 4» — one list, and NO «ואחר כך:» anywhere
cases.before: «… כתבו קודם «משולש ABC», ואחר כך בשורה נפרדת «∠ABC = 90°». ואחר כך: (3) AB = 4» — a list that began at (3) with no (1) or (2) on screen

cases.title: Two facts on one line now end at a two-item list
cases.lookFor: The same list, ending at (2). This one is a CHANGE beyond the reported case — the two messages were merged into one format
cases.before: The same two lines taught as prose, with no numbers

cases.title: A non-flat «מרובע» from fixed coordinates is REFUSED
cases.lookFor: The first four lines record; the fifth is refused — «הנתונים סותרים זה את זה — אין גוף שמקיים את «מרובע ABCD» יחד עם …» — and the four points stay on the canvas
cases.before: All five lines recorded green and drew a FOLDED quadrilateral, D five units off the plane of A, B, C

cases.title: The same refusal through a solid's own letters
cases.lookFor: The second line is refused, naming «מרובע ABCA'» and «קובייה ABCDA'B'C'D'»
cases.before: Recorded green as a flat quadrilateral across three faces of the cube

cases.title: A ring with a FREE corner must still build (the ruled boundary)
cases.lookFor: All three lines record and the quadrilateral is built — D is still free, so it rides into the plane. This is the case your 2026-10-09 ruling said must NOT be refused
cases.before: unchanged

cases.title: A height to the base reaches the opposite SIDE
cases.lookFor: The perpendicular from A reaches side BC at a new point E, with a right-angle knee at E and a segment AE of real length; all three lines green
cases.before: E was minted exactly on top of A — two labels on one dot, no visible altitude, green anyway — and the third line was then refused as a contradiction

cases.title: A trapezoid's height picks the PARALLEL base
cases.lookFor: E lands on DC — the side parallel to AB, not on BC — with AE perpendicular to it
cases.before: E on top of A

cases.title: REFUSAL — a midpoint apex has no opposite side to drop onto
cases.lookFor: The third line is refused: ««הבסיס» הוא הבסיס של גוף — ובציור אין גוף אחד בדיוק…». The triangle and D stay; nothing new is drawn. Judge the wording: it is honest and names your own word «הבסיס», but it talks about a גוף when you drew a flat triangle — tell me if you want it reworded
cases.before: It drew a perpendicular to the triangle's own PLANE — a height to nothing — and reported green

cases.title: A real solid's base is untouched (regression guard)
cases.lookFor: Unchanged: the foot lands inside the base face ABC with SE perpendicular to it — a real height
cases.before: unchanged

cases.title: A trapezoid's height now builds in analytic
cases.lookFor: The last line is ACCEPTED and E is drawn at (0,3) — straight up from A onto the upper base DC, with the right-angle knee at E
cases.before: Refused: «אין בשרטוט משולש…» (cevian-no-triangle), although 2-D built it

cases.title: A parallelogram's height too
cases.lookFor: Accepted, E on side BC with AE perpendicular to it (BC is the side 2-D picks for a parallelogram)
cases.before: Refused

cases.title: REFUSAL — a median on a ring stays refused (2-D does not host it either)
cases.lookFor: Refused — the height was widened to rings, the median deliberately was not, because 2-D does not read it on a ring either
cases.before: unchanged

cases.title: Two shapes share the apex, so the tool now ASKS
cases.lookFor: It asks which shape you meant, offering «AE גובה לצלע BC» or «AE גובה במשולש ABC» — this is new, and it is what 2-D does
cases.before: It silently drew the triangle's height, never mentioning the quadrilateral

cases.title: An unrelated point no longer silences the crossing refusal
lines: P נקודת החיתוך של הישר AD עם הישר EF
cases.lookFor: The last line is REFUSED, naming E: «נקודת החיתוך של הישר AD עם הישר EF היא E, ולנקודה הזאת כבר יש שם…», and no P is added
cases.before: Because «נקודה Q» was typed first, the line was accepted and P was drawn on top of E — two labels on one dot

cases.title: The net: a crossing clear of E still builds
lines: P נקודת החיתוך של הישר AD עם הישר EF
cases.lookFor: With E moved to (1,2) the crossing is clear of it, so the line RECORDS and P is drawn at (0,2). The fix must not refuse legitimate crossings
cases.before: unchanged

cases.title: A word that is not a number is no longer a point
cases.lookFor: Refused; the canvas stays empty, with no point «foo» and no ✓ row
cases.before: Accepted — a free point «foo» on the real axis at ≈2.09 with a ✓ «foo is real» row

cases.title: The same in English
cases.lookFor: The same single refusal; nothing drawn
cases.before: The same phantom point «foo»

cases.title: The imaginary unit is no longer claimed to be real
cases.lookFor: Refused, nothing drawn. This is the one I would most like a second opinion on
cases.before: A point «i» drawn at ≈2.24 on the real axis with a ✓ row claiming i IS real — simply false

cases.title: Names the figure really knows still work (regression guard)
cases.lookFor: u and u2 are drawn (u2 on the real axis, with a ✓ row); a12 draws nothing but is listed under parameters as «a12 — חופשי» with its own ✓ row. Length stopped mattering; the floor is the test
cases.before: unchanged
